summary: Frontend-only verification of Foundation in Christ Audio Companion Month 1 Voucher note on /quick-order. All 6 acceptance criteria PASS. Voucher note is visible only for Foundation card (meal.id='breakfast') when package='Meal Bundle (12 Lessons)' AND format is 'Workbook (Print)' (physical) or 'Digital Workbook' (ipdf). Hidden for eBook (epub), Snack Pack (any format: ipdf/epub), and Nibble (interactive/eLesson). Note does not appear on 4 C's of Christianity or any other card. Confirmed via global count: exactly 1 element with data-testid='foundation-audio-voucher-note' when active state, 0 otherwise. No JS errors/pageerror during interaction.
critical_code_review_comments: QuickOrder.js is 2315 lines - consider splitting into smaller modules (meal cards, package/format selectors, product data) for maintainability.

Format select does not have a data-testid (e.g., format-select-{meal.id}); package-select-{meal.id} has one. Adding format-select-{meal.id} would make future automated tests simpler and more reliable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voucher note testid = 'foundation-audio-voucher-note'. Foundation card package-select testid = 'package-select-breakfast'. Format values: physical=Workbook (Print), ipdf=Digital Workbook, epub=eBook, interactive=eLesson. Voucher shows only for meal+physical/ipdf combos on Foundation card. Format select currently has no data-testid; recommend adding one.
